newsitem.title: MEXICO: SOCCER-SCHUSTER LEAVES UNAM AFTER FOUR MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHUSTER LEAVES UNAM AFTER FOUR MONTHS.

text.p: German veteran Bernd Schuster left Mexican club UNAM on Sunday after just four months with the club after being told by coach Luis Flores that he would be used only as a substitute.

The 36-year-old midfielder, capped 21 caps for West Germany before he fell out with his team-mates in 1984, has only started six games since joining the club, nicknamed the Pumas, and appeared three times as a substitute.
